item.title: COMMERCIAL FIRE IN WILLIS
item.description: A fire alarm sounded at 101 County Line Road about 20 minutes ago. North Montgomery County Fire Crews had to force entry. Once they were inside the Texas Food Mart, they did find fire and called for additional units.
